title: Xi Jinping to Visit India for BRICS Summit — First Trip in Seven Years
detail: Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to travel to India for the BRICS summit in New Delhi, marking his first visit to India in seven years. The visit carries significant diplomatic weight given the context of recent India-China border tensions and ongoing efforts to normalize bilateral relations.

title: Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman Says He Was Not Invited to BRICS Summit
detail: Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has stated he was not invited to the BRICS summit in New Delhi, highlighting geopolitical exclusions shaping the gathering. The snub underscores ongoing tensions in South Asian regional dynamics and India's selective engagement with neighboring governments.
